newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM refuses to scrap special powers act.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM refuses to scrap special powers act.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Tuesday her government would not scrap the special powers act that allows police to detain suspects without trial for 90 days.

Replying to a question in parliament from the opposition on why the government, which itself criticised the act while in opposition, would not abrogate the law, the prime minister said it had proved useful for every government.
The law was enacted in 1974 by Hasina's father, Bangladesh's founding leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, who was killed in a military coup in 1975.
Opposition politicians have branded the act a "black law" used to harass the opposition.
